> Seeing the code, this means that they'll still see a warning when using the middleware with a non-Algolia analytics integration. Should we not rather explain (e.g., with a guide) how to create a middleware to plug their own analytics solution?

If they use the `insights` middleware for non-Algolia analytics integration, they must've had `onEvent` hook and go controlled mode. Then they don't end up going into that branch: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4724/files#diff-d934c60fefaa23618441fb40ed23c85dde8006e7661144b0434add680a996f62R125-R127
